description: Curated, trusted, held-out retrieval cases (blueprint §33 seed suite). Each corpus item is captured as evidence; each query has labelled relevant ids (the doc_id of the gold evidence) and a gold answer span for answer-quality scoring. Per §9 these are internal-only and never reported as a public benchmark (§12 N3).

corpus.content: The capital of France is Paris, located on the river Seine.
Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan and its most populous metropolis.
Rome is the capital city of Italy and the Lazio region.
Madrid is the capital of Spain on the Manzanares river.
The user prefers PostgreSQL as the primary production database backend.
The user writes services primarily in Python and dislikes heavyweight frameworks.
Deployment preference is local-first single binary with Postgres parity for production.
The quarterly planning meeting was moved from Monday to Thursday at 3pm.
The infrastructure budget for next quarter is capped at forty thousand dollars.
On-call rotations switch every Wednesday morning between the two backend engineers.
The river Seine is roughly seven hundred and seventy seven kilometres long.
